messages.content: What am I looking at?
Stanford bunny, 1994. A 3D print of a scanned clay rabbit. Greg Turk and Marc Levoy scanned it at Stanford; its mesh became a standard test model in computer graphics.

What am I looking at?
Rubber duck in a glass bowl, undated. Vinyl, glass and water. The curved glass and the water bend the light around it.
What am I looking at?
Rubber duck, undated. Yellow vinyl, beside a laptop. Programmers explain their code to it line by line and often find the bug while talking: rubber-duck debugging.

Utah teapot, 1974. Glazed white ceramic. Martin Newell measured this Melitta teapot to make one of the first 3D computer models; it became the test object of computer graphics.
